visualPreparation.prompt:
CULTIVAR-SPECIFIC VISUAL EVIDENCE (highest priority): the official T-1000 mother-cut flower reference shows dense stacked flowering clusters, narrow-to-medium serrated leaves, strong visible trichome coverage, pale-to-rust pistils, and a dark green to burgundy-purple leaf coloration tendency. Do not infer whole-plant silhouette, branching pattern, or internode spacing from the close-up reference.
CULTIVAR IDENTITY CONTEXT: T-1000 S1 by Humboldt CSI; S1/selfed generation; T-1000 × T-1000. The reference is the mother cut and is used only as a bounded morphology tendency, not proof of uniformity across every S1 plant.
PHOTOGRAPHIC CONSTRAINTS: photorealistic botanical reference photography; single mature female cannabis plant; complete plant visible; natural light; neutral non-distracting background; no text; no collage; no packaging; no smoke.
NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS: no fruit or berries; no people; no labels or logos; no jars, bags, boxes or bottles; no smoke; no unrelated objects; no fantasy anatomy; do not invent cultivar-specific whole-plant architecture where the reference does not show it.

evidence.description: [EVIDENCE_ALIGNMENT=REQUIRED] OFFICIAL_VISUAL_EVIDENCE: Close-up reference shows dense stacked flowering clusters, narrow-to-medium serrated sugar/fan leaves, strong visible trichome coverage, pale-to-rust pistils, and a dark green to burgundy-purple leaf coloration tendency. Whole-plant silhouette, branching pattern, and internode spacing are not observable.
The official page identifies the product as T-1000 × T-1000 and explicitly labels the pictured flower as the T-1000 mother cut; visual extraction is limited to traits visible in that reference.
